_handoff.scopeNote: Unauthenticated public-workflow pass for a Bengaluru/Karnataka domestic LPG connection address or distributor change. Current official Bharatgas, IndianOil/Indane and HP Gas public page renderings were inspected through their visible guidance and entry boundaries; the Bharatgas mylang host was unavailable to direct browser navigation in this environment, so its indexed official page text is retained with that limitation. No login, OTP, consumer number, address, upload, payment, distributor lookup, transfer request, or submission was attempted.

claims.text: Bharatgas publicly describes LPG connection portability as available in selected cities and says no transfer fee or additional security deposit is charged for that option.
claims.notes: The page does not establish that Bengaluru is currently included or that a particular connection qualifies.

claims.text: Bharatgas's public portability lead sends the user to a login page requiring login ID, password and CAPTCHA before the portability route can be entered.
claims.notes: No login, CAPTCHA, OTP or account information was supplied.

claims.text: Bharatgas exposes a public distributor locator with state and district selectors, but no distributor or service-area result is established without selecting a location.
claims.notes: No Bengaluru state/district selection or distributor lookup was made.

claims.text: Bharatgas's public downloads section lists a unified form for LPG connection transfer or regularization.
claims.notes: The listing and blank form are not evidence of approval, current case eligibility or a completed submission.

claims.text: IndianOil's current public FAQ describes three Indane branches: same distributor area uses new-address proof for a record change; same-town transfer uses SV, TTV, DGCC and TSV without equipment surrender; out-of-town transfer uses SV/TSV and DGCC with equipment surrender for a TV and later reconnection.
claims.notes: Published FAQ sequence only; no Bengaluru distributor, document variant, account state or real transfer result was checked.

claims.text: HPCL's current public FAQ describes within-city or adjoining-city transfer using an e-CTA authorization code with SV and new-distributor enrollment, while an outside-town transfer uses a TV, equipment surrender/refund and reconnection at the new place.
claims.notes: The FAQ is HP Gas-specific and does not establish the route for Bharatgas or Indane.

claims.text: HPCL publicly says its portability option can cover an in-city residence change or dissatisfaction with the current distributor, but the request is initiated through HP Gas portal or HPPAY user login and validated by OTP.
claims.notes: No HP login, OTP or portability request was attempted.

claims.text: This public pass does not establish the current OMC, assigned Bengaluru distributor, service-area match, accepted proof variant, account-specific eligibility, fee other than Bharatgas's portability statement, processing status, approval, consumer-number change or delivery result for any real connection.
claims.notes: The reviewed official routes stop at public guidance, selectors, forms or authenticated boundaries. No login, OTP, lookup, upload, payment or submission occurred.
